tei:div.tei:p: go shri dpal 'byor don grub kyi lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /go shri dpal 'byor don grub ni/ snye bo yag steng zhes par sku 'khrungs/ lo lnga bzhes dus rje mthong ba don ldan gyis mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug dang ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi sprul par ngos 'dzin dang skra 'dzin mdzad/ bcu bzhi par mkhan chen mgo blon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gshegs pa'i go sar gu'i gung par mnga' gsol/ sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren par dgongs te/ zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ rje 'jam dpal bzang po rnams la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang*/ bstan 'gyur las lung rgyun bzhugs pa rnams kyi lung dang*/ gsar rnying gi dbang lung bod 'dir bzhugs so 'tshal rnams zhu+u bar mngags/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa nos/ gong ma tā ming cing thung rgyal pos/ gu shrī'i las ka 'ja' sa gser tham/ las zhwa mthon mthing rnams phul kyang*/ las zhwa rje nyid dang 'dra bas rnam 'gyur dang 'gal bar gzigs nas rdo rje 'chang gi nang rten du bzhugs/ rje mthong ba don ldan gsa' phur phebs te rten rnams dang dbu zhwa sogs la phyag rgyas btab cing phyag dpe sogs go shri la gtad nas zhi bar gshegs pas/ mtshur phur sku gdung gi mchod rten dang sku tshab gzim sku bzhengs/ gser thog gi zhig gso gnang*/ rgyal tshab tu bzhugs nas sgar gyi 'dzin skyong mdzad/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho zla ngo dgu bzhes pa ste bo dgon sar du mjal/ dgung lo lnga pa sa stag gi lor/ tshe dpag med phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang phul bde mchog me tri bcu gsum dang*/ sgyu ma chen po'i dbang phul skabs de dag zhal gzigs/ dus 'khor dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang mdzad/ rta lor karma dgon du sprul pa'i skur dge tshul gnang*/ mtshan chos grags rgya mtsho dpal bzang por gsol kre khang dmar du zhwa dmar bzhi par yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang*/ lug lo zla ba dang por phag mo lha lnga/

ber gyi gtor dbang*/ lha mo zhing skyong*/ rta mgrin dpa' bo lha bzhi/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu lnga/ rta mgrin khams gsum yongs sgrol/ rngog lugs dgyes rdor lha dgu /bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga/ bde mchog snyan brgyud skor/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ phyag chen ye shes gsal byed/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ mi la'i rnam mgur/ don ldan zhabs dang mkha' spyod pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams mdzad/ karmar ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku brnyan rje bdun pa'i bka' stsal ltar si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor dang bcas pas bzhengs par mdzad/ sku gshegs kar go shrī'i lung dang lag rtags thams cad sprul pa'i sku zhwa dmar par gnang ste/ dgung lo drug bcu re gsum gyi bar du gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor te sa khyi lor mtshur phur mya ngan las 'das/ sku gdung zhugs su bzhus tshe 'ja' 'od dang me tog sna tshogs kyi char bab pa'i nang nas/ me tog yu ba can zhig dus phyis rten sgrom du'ang bzhugs/ thugs rang byon ni sgar gyi rten khrod du bzhugs/ dbu thod ni mchod rten du bzhugs te gzhung lugs gling du bzhugs pa'o//
